purpose: Detect and reject manufactured diversity that relies on IDs, salts, names, dates or cosmetic wording while leaving substantive combinations unchanged.
status: SPEC_ONLY — detector not executed; no cases scanned

hitIfAny.name: identity_only_delta
hitIfAny.rule: Combined semantic signature equal after normalisation; only caseId/packet salt/orderIndex differ.

hitIfAny.name: name_date_only_delta
hitIfAny.rule: Combined signature equal; only person names, DOBs, incident dates, or listing dates differ.

hitIfAny.name: synonym_reskin
hitIfAny.rule: Facts/parties/evidence/procedure/defence/missing/behaviour axes unchanged; surface wording synonymised or templated.

hitIfAny.name: boilerplate_padding
hitIfAny.rule: Added or varied universal safety wording, disclaimers, or stock uncertainty phrases with no substantive axis change.

hitIfAny.name: layout_noise_as_uniqueness
hitIfAny.rule: Rotation/OCR crush/duplicate-page/whitespace-only difference claimed as uniqueness without truth-keyed assertion change.

hitIfAny.name: label_swap_without_instrument_change
hitIfAny.rule: Charge-family or tier label changed without charge instrument, facts, or evidence-graph change.

hitIfAny.name: shard_local_reskin
hitIfAny.rule: Matter mirrored across shards with CUR-01..07 deltas only.
